lib/paint/style: StampPainting loads a scene's three.js sources on its device's owner and renders them each frame.
lib/paint/shot: A shot draws a three.js source as the three layers build it, with its painted textures.
lib/paint/gate: The gate loads a three.js cylinder through the three-source loader, its material reading a painted texture as a shot's three source would; and builds the lit shot's stands as three sources (soft shadows, a planar mirror pass following the camera), loading one apart to render exposures and reading them through the camera a three plane renders through (painted-three-camera).
